# Calculate the number of days between the two dates
# First, convert the date strings to datetime objects
df['Date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['Date'], format='%d %B %Y')
# Extract unique dates for the given dates
date1 = pd.to_datetime('31 October 2008', format='%d %B %Y')
date2 = pd.to_datetime('1 November 2008', format='%d %B %Y')
# Compute the absolute difference in days
days_diff = abs((date2 - date1).days)
answer = days_diff
